title: openai-chat-completions-parity-params-roles-stop-logprobs-formatting-streaming-stability
author: Evan Turner
description:
Motivation: Bring Redwood's /v1/chat.completions compatibility layer fully in parity with OpenAI semantics for params, roles, stop tokens, logprobs, and response formatting while improving streaming stability and tool/function-calling behavior. This PR unifies param handling across sync/stream paths, tightens role normalization, restores historical stop/logprobs semantics, and hardens the streaming state machine to avoid dropped events under backpressure.

Summary of changes: consolidated request param parsing (temperature, top_p, presence/ frequency penalties, n) into a single canonical mapper; preserved legacy stop token semantics and added explicit stop token unit tests; return logprobs for both sync and streaming responses (when requested) and ensure partial-logprobs are emitted consistently during streaming chunks; normalized message role handling to accept common OpenAI role variants and preserve original role string in structured output; stabilized streaming by serializing event flushes, adding a streaming-write watchdog, and retrying transient send failures for tool calls; documented structured output format differences and added compatibility flags.

Checklist: - [x] API parity for params and roles validated against existing OpenAI compatibility test vectors - [x] Streaming stability tests (unit + integration) - [x] Tool/function calling edge case tests (tool timeout, partial outputs) - [x] Added docs and examples for structured output and formatting differences - [x] Benchmarked latency impact (see CI perf job)

Testing and validation: ran full unit test suite, integration tests against openai-compat test harness, and e2e smoke tests using the example chat-app. CI perf job shows <2% median p50 token latency regression for 99th-percentile streaming requests; batching behavior unchanged. Manual validation against Linear testcases ENG-3124 and ENG-3180 reproduced previously reported stop/logprobs mismatch and confirmed fix.

Notes: this PR intentionally keeps a short-lived compatibility flag (openai_compat_v2) to allow a staged rollout for customers on Dedicated. Follow-up will remove the flag after one release window and after usage telemetry stabilizes.
commits: a2d4f1c: refactor(openai_compat): centralize param mapper and add unit tests
b4c3e9a: feat(streaming): add streaming watchdog and serialized flushes to prevent interleaved events
c5f6b2d: fix(tooling): retry transient writes for tool/function calls and surface tool metadata in events
d7e8a4f: test(openai_compat): add parity vectors for stop tokens and logprobs (sync + streaming)
e9f0a1b: docs: update docs/openai_compat.md with structured output examples and migration notes
review_comments: Priya Desai (reviewer): Please add a unit test for partial-logprobs emitted across multiple streaming chunks. The current tests cover full response only.
Evan Turner (author): Added partial-logprobs unit tests and updated integration test harness to assert chunk-aligned logprobs event ordering.
Nora Li (reviewer): I found a race when a tool call returns immediately with an empty body; added a suggestion to normalize empty tool outputs to an explicit empty string event.
Evan Turner (author): Applied Nora's suggestion and added a small e2e test that exercises empty-tool outputs over the streaming path.
Markus Chen (approver): Verified perf numbers and test coverage. Approving once CI passes cleanly.
release_notes: OpenAI /v1/chat.completions parity: canonicalized params mapping, role normalization, restored stop/logprobs semantics for sync and streaming, stabilized streaming flush semantics, improved tool/function-call robustness, and docs for structured output.
